title: ERP® Certification (Energy Risk Professional)
source: GARP Energy Risk Professional Curriculum & Foundations
summary: The specialized energy risk benchmark covering physical crude oil, natural gas, LNG, power grids, refining margins, emissions, and financial energy derivatives across physical and financial trading regimes.

standard.name: Standard Energy Risk Track
standard.blurb: Master physical commodity mechanics and financial derivatives, pass the comprehensive examination, and document 2 years of energy market experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Physical Energy Commodities & Infrastructure
stages.subtitle: Crude oil, natural gas, power generation, and refining economics

nodes.name: Physical Crude Oil & Refining Margins
nodes.description: Upstream exploration, global crude benchmarks (Brent, WTI, Dubai), pipeline and tanker transport logistics, refinery crack spreads (3:2:1 crack), and petroleum product blending.
topics: Crude Oil Assay Properties: API Gravity, Sulfur Content & Sweet/Sour Spreads
Geopolitics, OPEC+ Quotas & Global Energy Flow Routing
Refinery Configurations: Atmospheric Distillation, Fluid Catalytic Cracking & Coking
Refining Economics: 3:2:1 Crack Spreads, Spark Spreads & Netback Valuation

nodes.name: Natural Gas & LNG Logistics
nodes.description: Natural gas geology, pipeline transmission tariffs, underground storage injection/withdrawal cycles, Henry Hub pricing, and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) liquefaction/regasification.
topics: Natural Gas Gathering, Processing & Pipeline Transport Hydraulics
Underground Storage Mechanics: Working Gas vs Cushion Gas & Seasonal Cycling
Global LNG Supply Chains, Floating Storage Regasification (FSRU) & Netback Parity

nodes.name: Electric Power Grids & Generation Economics
nodes.description: Power grid physics, dispatch merit order, heat rates, locational marginal pricing (LMP), transmission line congestion, capacity markets, and renewable energy integration.
topics: Electricity Deregulation, ISOs/RTOs & Wholesale Electricity Markets
Generation Merit Order, Heat Rates & Spark/Dark Spreads
Locational Marginal Pricing (LMP) & Financial Transmission Rights (FTRs)
Emissions Trading Systems (EU ETS), Carbon Offsets & Clean Energy Transition

stages.title: Stage 2: Financial Energy Derivatives, Valuation & Hedging
stages.subtitle: Swaps, options, ETRM systems, Energy VaR, and comprehensive exam

nodes.name: Financial Energy Derivatives & Hedging
nodes.description: Futures contracts, commodity forwards, swing contracts, crack spread options, spark spread options, storage arbitrage, and airline/refinery fuel hedging programs.
topics: Commodity Futures Curves: Contango, Backwardation, Convenience Yield & Roll Yield
Energy Swaps: Fixed-for-Floating, Basis Swaps & Index-Linked Swaps
Exotic Energy Options: Asian Options, Spread Options, Swing Contracts & Tolling Agreements
Corporate Energy Risk Hedging Programs for Airlines, Utilities & Producers

nodes.name: Energy Risk Metrics & Trading Systems (ETRM)
nodes.description: Energy Value at Risk (CFaR, EaR), non-normal commodity price distributions, extreme tail risk, Counterparty Credit Risk, and Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) systems.
topics: Energy VaR: Historical Simulation & Jumps in Electricity Spot Prices
Cash Flow at Risk (CFaR) & Earnings at Risk (EaR) in Energy Utilities
Counterparty Credit Risk in OTC Energy Bilateral Contracts & ISDA CSAs
ETRM System Architecture, Deal Capture & Regulatory Reporting (Dodd-Frank, REMIT)

nodes.name: ERP Comprehensive Examination
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing physical energy markets, infrastructure, financial derivatives, and commodity risk management models.

stages.title: Stage 3: Experience & Credential Award
stages.subtitle: 2 Years Energy Risk Experience + Code of Conduct

nodes.name: 2 Years Professional Energy Risk Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least 2 years of professional work experience in energy commodity trading, physical logistics, risk management, or utility treasury.
topics: 24 Months Energy Experience
Supervisory Verification

nodes.name: Certified ERP Designation Conferred & Ethics
nodes.description: Award of the Energy Risk Professional (ERP®) certification and commitment to upholding the GARP Code of Conduct.
topics: Certified ERP Credential Award
GARP Code of Conduct Adherence
